summary: Brother of John's 3rd-great-grandmother Catherine Scott, a Kingston, Pennsylvania, man who married Margaret Ann Davis; John's 3rd-great-grand-uncle.
bio: Henry Scott was born on 24 May 1829, probably a son of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston, Pennsylvania, and a brother of John's 3rd-great-grandmother Catherine Scott. He was 21 and still at home in 1850; his father Stephen J. Scott died at Kingston on 19 April 1856. Henry married Margaret Ann Davis (1834–1884), and their children were born from 1853; a son, Walter S. Scott, later married in New York. Henry died on 7 April 1895.

researchNotes:
Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable). 21 in 1850.

FamilySearch gives Henry a death date of 7 Apr 1895 and a wife, Margaret Ann Davis (1834-1884), with children from 1853. A New York county marriage record of a son, Walter S. Scott, names Henry as his father ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch dates Stephen J. Scott's death to 19 Apr 1856 at Kingston.
